purpose: Required next engineering work, separate from completed outline calculations and any integrated selection

tasks.task: Detail real motor/gear housings, shaft offsets, revised bogie frame and mounts; resolve clashes before installed admission

tasks.dependency: running gear analysis and physical tests
tasks.task: Verify actual wheel tread/flange profiles, contact, clearances, wear and derailment protection; nominal rail-head-centre alignment is a declared geometry hypothesis
Independently evaluate tapered underframe, welds, local buckling, fatigue, crash and load-transfer joints
Verify real bearing contact, segment joints, cracking, prestress, fatigue and construction stages; an elastic method comparison does not establish these
Resolve actual turnout geometry, single-sided platform access, interlocking, standstill jerk, brake/adhesion/WSP and degraded rescue
Replace generic transfer ceilings with measured force-stroke/pressure-flow/contact, reset and hot repeated-duty characteristics
Explore explicit minimum-worthwhile release and early-disengagement policies; positive residual energy can occupy a bank and bypass a later capture
Verify converter/collector short-circuit protection, conductor ampacity, battery hot-current/cooling/fire behaviour and station peak duty
Replace proposed stock/envelopes with controlled mating drawings, tolerances, qualified procedures, fixtures and inspection release
Carry an explicitly selected complete configuration into city-specific grades, surveys, demand, utilities and ground; do not multiply pilot costs into cities
